g.text: McCabe–Thiele steps alternate equilibrium contact and operating-line balance
Same model and operating lines as776–777. Start at (x_D,x_D) for a total condenser, which is not counted as an equilibrium stage. The final horizontal
step goes below x_B; a fractional final-stage interpolation is needed for a noninteger count. Constant molar overflow and equilibrium stages are
